data.narrative:
Deterrence is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $10M+. The valuation assessment draws from a comparison universe of 10 total comps (2 public, 8 private) operating in the Defense & Security sector. Key private peers include UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic; public comps trade as DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $25M valuation. The Peer-Median approach examines 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—including Series A companies Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), NODA AI ($125M), and Seed-stage UFORCE ($1.0B)—yielding a median of $1.0B and a range of $125M to $4.0B.

These methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $21M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $512M. The wide spread—driven substantially by peer-set heterogeneity across stage and scale—reflects material uncertainty. Key variables warranting further investigation include stage-appropriate revenue or traction metrics, capital efficiency relative to comps, and the representativeness of the defense-sector peer set given the company's specific operational focus and market position.
